PREFIX ref: <http://brickschema.org/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?ts WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?lbl .
  FILTER (?lbl IN ("Perimeter_ZN_3","Perimeter_ZN_4"))
  ?zone brick:hasTemperatureSensor ?ts .
}
